summary: Preserve computed names of static fields/methods/accessors, whose key expressions are evaluated during class definition.

target.notes: Evaluate the key expression at class definition, convert it with ToPropertyKey, and define the corresponding property on the runtime constructor object.

caveats: C# static member names are compile-time identifiers and cannot represent arbitrary string/Symbol property keys.

tests.name: computed static field key
tests.input: let n=0; const k=()=>`x${++n}`; class C { static [k()]=1; } console.log(n,C.x1);

tests.name: edge: Symbol key
tests.input: const s=Symbol(); class C { static [s]=7; } console.log(C[s]);
